pageDescription: Monitor and control network activity on this device — see which apps are connecting where, scan for open ports, and check destinations against threat intelligence. On-device and metadata-only, never traffic contents.
noConnections: No active outbound connections right now.
scanHint: TCP connect scan (no root needed). Presets: 'top' for well-known ports, or ranges like 1-1024 and lists like 22,80,443. Defaults to this device (127.0.0.1).
noOpenPorts: No open ports found in the scanned range.
feedHint: JSON array of indicators (value, type: domain|ip|cidr, category). Prefilled with a labeled example set — replace with a real feed such as URLhaus, ThreatFox, or abuse.ch.
spnDescription: A multi-hop, onion-style encrypted network (inspired by Safing's SPN) that routes each app's traffic through independent relays so no single hop sees both who you are and where you're going. This requires dedicated relay infrastructure and a hardened tunnel client, so it is on the roadmap — not enabled yet. See docs/architecture for the design.
